status: Ten selection-ready proposals; no runtime or asset integration authorized
jump_physics: Open research; neither current1.2s nor proposed alternatives are assumed final.
scale: Hero and110px short-board references are illustrative; generated views are not orthographic collision plans.90x28 full support footprint remains design baseline.
fast_readability: At far-right rider position, screen-entry-to-contact can be~0.47s. Demanding sequences need advance/offscreen cue plus distant silhouette; artwork alone does not establish reaction safety.
rules: Current ordinary obstacles/gaps remain1HP with existing immunity/latches. Only10 proposes a lethal exception; no policy changed.
consultation: Mechanics and Level Design supplied concrete feasibility cautions. No code, course, runtime asset or physics edits.
ideas_bank: Reviewed matching optional hazard entries; no unapproved bank entry added to implementation.

options.name: Valve-Stem Slalom
options.intent: Alternating bank-connected valve bases close both edge bypasses and require a near/far weave.
options.validation_needed: Validate full-board-expanded footprints so no straight center or edge bypass remains; spacing and steering time at560px/s remain unvalidated.

options.name: Elbow-Pipe Breach
options.intent: Pass around a large protruding elbow; the broken pipe core is distinct from its foam.
options.validation_needed: Keep the opening and spray from obscuring the actual solid contact core.

options.name: Chain-Hung Plug
options.intent: A suspended rubber plug blocks rider space; its water-plane shadow marks the lane to avoid.
options.validation_needed: Validate both standing Tony and seated Sean head clearance. Inset costumes are illustrative, not replacement character art.

options.name: Drain-Brush Curtain
options.intent: Hanging brushes and cables leave a readable open lane. Steer through rather than jump.
options.validation_needed: Advance silhouettes and shadows must reveal the next curtain before screen entry.

options.name: Loose Flange Hop
options.intent: Hop a low flange ridge with a visible recovery-water stretch beyond.
options.validation_needed: Size the full ring traversal after jump research; the interior contains water, not a lethal pit.

options.name: Float-Arm Sweep
options.intent: A hinged cistern float sweeps one lane; a clear bypass avoids its marked sweep zone.
options.validation_needed: Moving-obstacle timing and guaranteed bypass need separate validation.

options.name: Cleanout-Cap Islands
options.intent: Broad cleanout covers offer whole-board landing decks between unsupported slots.
options.validation_needed: Target about three board lengths per deck as a study, not a final dimension. Generated profile brackets are illustrative and not measurements.

options.name: Broken-Basin Hopscotch
options.intent: Staggered porcelain slabs combine lane choice with full-board landings and recovery room.
options.validation_needed: Needs supported-platform mechanics and validated landing/input recovery before chaining hops.

options.name: Buckled Drain Grate
options.intent: Jagged fixed metal spikes protrude through the buckled grate, visibly signaling damaging contact. Jump the complete spike envelope.
options.validation_needed: Keep spikes distinct from boost ramps; validate board clearance above the tallest tip and safe landing beyond the entire hazard.

options.name: Emergency Flume Launch
options.intent: A chevron-marked flume launches across an exceptionally long pit into a broad catch basin.
options.validation_needed: Missing the ramp would cause death: proposed exception to current1HP obstacle policy, requiring explicit selection and validation. Ordinary hops must visibly fall short.

marketing_retention: Sean explicitly requests preservation for potential magazine use. All originals and revisions retained.
